feature: Strict Audius ISRC rescue and two curated recordings verified against official excerpts and full-file SHA-256, using the existing HTMLAudio player without video.
invariants: Downloaded audio, podcasts and explicitly added YouTube entries retain their own identity/source.
An explicitly selected source is not silently replaced after rejection.
Only catalog matches can use the new rescue; no automatic fuzzy Archive or HearThis substitution.
Curated complete files must pass byte count and SHA-256 before the exact checked bytes become a RAM Blob.
Only a proven exactly-zero prefix is skipped; real duration/timeline and explicit seeks are preserved.
Playable source URLs, capabilities and signed media addresses are never serialized into queue/library metadata.

media.scope: 36 controlled-provider media scenarios plus two setup checks per desktop engine; real AAC. Includes matching Audius fallback, homonym rejection and automatic next with the same Audio. Not a new all-suite run or physical phone test.

officialVideoRegression.scope: Benign iframe HTTP fixtures; no YouTube playback/autoplay claim.

compiledRealLocalUi.scope: Six UI checks each for Iritsi and Egiozu: one normal title click, full checked Blob, seek, repeat with offline network and hidden tab, and Back/navigation. Desktop Chrome; no physical screen lock.

compiledRealPublicUi.scope: The same six UI cases per curated song, repeated against actual published Pages assets and real providers with one title click, standard browser security and userGesture:false observation. Desktop Chrome, not a physical phone.

audiusDownloads.scope: Real permitted Audius control, full CORS transfer, duration/tail validation, product CacheStorage/IDB and service worker, offline native audio and seek; control is transport proof, not a new catalog association.

update.scope: Real controlling service worker, playlist/duplicate/library/podcast/download bytes persist through update; desktop isolated site.

earlierAttempts.reason: Official-player test harness had not declared the two new forbidden resolver dependencies. Updated harness imports preserve forbidden-call assertions; final 501 tests pass.
Pre-Archive candidate; all its reports retain their own build and are not reassigned to the final release.

QA observer/protocol/UI-target corrections only: old Chrome offline wrapper incompatibility, autofocus/frame wait, and selecting a real album page before testing its Back control. No second playback gesture was used to rescue autoplay.

Earlier published worker returned full 200 bodies to readable Range requests, leaving final seek validation pending. Final product adds local readable 206/416 responses; final full/offline gate passes.

limitations: Generic Audius matching relies on provider metadata and cannot prove the audio of a malicious/mislabeled upload.
Curated acoustic comparisons cover approximately 30-second official excerpts, not every second of the master; full-file SHA binds playback to the file actually checked.
ALEA playback retains its real padded-file duration (about 187 seconds; browser MP3 estimates can vary after seeking); it does not rewrite or truncate musical audio.
Curated RAM Blobs can repeat offline in the open document, but are not persistent offline downloads. ALEA/Archive downloading is disabled.
Physical Xiaomi and iPhone background/screen-off checks for this build remain pending; previous device reports do not validate this release.
HearThis and Jamendo are not enabled. Archive is a curated exact association, not a general fuzzy catalog fallback.
Android Auto and CarPlay remain outside this static PWA distribution.
